title: Indemnity amortization experiment and sales pre-clearance gating for MSA/DPA redlines
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: We need a practical way to accept or escalate MSA/DPA indemnity/liability redlines that balances legal risk with predictable pricing for customers and predictable revenue for Redwood. This ticket scopes an experiment that (1) scores redline indemnity exposure and maps it to an amortized pricing surcharge, (2) exposes a sales pre-clearance gating UI for fast auto-accept below a computed threshold, and (3) integrates security questionnaire (SSQ) answers to adjust thresholds for regulated customers.

Motivation: Sales frequently encounter customers whose redlines have quantifiable but acceptable financial exposure if amortized over contract term. Legal's current manual review creates friction and inconsistent outcomes. By surface-quantifying exposure and enabling a guarded auto-accept path with buy-side pricing, we reduce deal cycle time and provide defensible guardrails for Legal and Finance.

Proposal details:
- Redline Scorer: Produce a deterministic scoring model that consumes MSA/DPA indemnity clauses and numeric inputs (liability cap, exclusions, escrow, carveouts) and outputs an exposure score and an equivalent monthly surcharge per seat (amortization). The model will be implemented as a small service (scoring microservice) with a lightweight rule engine + tunable coefficients.
- Sales Pre-clearance UI: In the Deal Desk console, surface the score and suggested surcharge. If the score < auto_accept_threshold, allow Sales to auto-accept the redline and apply the surcharge to the quote. If score >= threshold, route to Legal with recommended tiered review levels.
- SSQ linkage: Map specific SSQ responses (e.g., data residency, PCI/SOC requirements) to multiplier adjustments on the exposure score. This reduces false negatives for high-regulation customers.
- Telemetry & Audit: Record per-deal scoring inputs, decision taken (auto-accept vs legal route), time-to-decision, and buyer churn signals. Store immutable audit artifacts for later legal review.

Success metrics (experiment):
- Reduce median redline decision TTD (time-to-decision) from baseline 4.2 days to <= 1.5 days for auto-accepted cases.
- Increase sales self-service acceptance rate of minor redlines from 12% to >= 50% in pilot segment.
- No >1% increase in indemnity-related claim exposure on aggregate (measured via simulated stress test and legal post-mortem).

Implementation notes & trade-offs:
- Simplicity first: initial scorer is rules + weighted heuristics rather than ML. That makes behavior explainable to Legal and auditable.
- Conservative thresholds to start; will expand after a 6-week mirrored run with Legal in the loop.
- Pricing impact estimation uses contract term normalization (amortize cap over 36 months by default) and per-seat or per-commit unit depending on SKU. Finance will validate amortization assumptions.
- Risk: mis-scoring could approve an unacceptable contract. Mitigations: (a) immutable logging, (b) canary pilot limited to SMB/midmarket, (c) manual spot-checks, (d) emergency rollback toggle in Deal Desk.

Open questions for Legal/Finance/Product:
1) Default amortization window (12 / 24 / 36 months)?
2) Which contract elements should be overridable by Sales with mandatory escalation reasons?
3) How to handle global/regulatory carveouts (e.g., cross-border data transfer liability)?

Next steps and timeline:
- Week 0–1: align with Legal & Finance on scoring factors (Confluence: link below).
- Week 2–4: build scoring prototype and Deal Desk UI mock (Design: link).
- Week 5–6: pilot in mirrored mode (score-only, no auto-accept) for 2 sales pods.
- Week 7–10: enable guarded auto-accept with low threshold for SMB pilot, monitor metrics, iterate.

Stakeholders: Legal (review lead: Priya Kapoor), Finance (review lead: Mateo Ruiz), Sales Ops (owner: Nora Patel), Design (owner: Jin Park), Engineering (owner: Liam Chen).

Artifacts & reference links: Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENT/pages/Indemnity+Amortization+PRD; Design mock: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DesignMock; Pilot dashboard (internal): https://dash.redwood.ai/d/pilot/indemnity-amortization; Scoring prototype repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/indemnity-scorer-proto.

Acceptance criteria for ticket: scoring prototype in repo, Deal Desk UI mock uploaded, Legal sign-off on initial rules, pilot telemetry dashboard charting TTD and acceptance rate, rollback guard implemented.
